question: I got a call from someone saying they're from RBI and my KYC is expired, asking me to transfer money to a new account to reactivate my banking. Is this true?
reference_answer: RBI does not ask individuals to deposit money into personal accounts or share KYC details, OTPs, or passwords; you should immediately contact your bank branch and ignore such calls.

question: I received a message asking me to enter my PIN to receive money, and I entered it, and now money has been taken from my account. What should I do right away to stop more loss?
reference_answer: You should immediately report the unauthorized transaction to your bank or financial service provider and ask them to block your card, account, or wallet to prevent any further losses.

question: கவுன்டரி ஊழியராக behaupting கேட்டு எனது OTP அடுத்து, ஒரு ஆப் டவுன்லோड செய்தேன். இப்போது என்ன செய்ய வேண்டும்?
reference_answer: Immediately inform your bank or e-wallet provider about the OTP sharing and app download, and report it as unauthorized. Check your internet or mobile banking beneficiary list for any unknown additions, and block all modes of debit including UPI right away. Also, contact your bank only through its official website or branch, and notify the local police or cybercrime branch.

question: என் பங்கேற்பு கணக்கில் தவறு கேட்டோர்'appel செய்தார், அப்பில் அப்க் டவுன்லோட் செய்ய வேண்டியதாக கேட்டார்கள். என்ன செய்ய வேண்டும்?
reference_answer: You should not download any app or click links as claimed. Instead, contact the bank or service provider directly using official channels, block the scam number immediately, and never share OTPs or financial details over the phone.

question: I got a call saying I won a large sum from the RBI, and they want my personal banking info to transfer the money. What should I do?
reference_answer: The passage clarifies that RBI does not hold accounts for individuals and never asks for personal banking details or passwords, and warns that responding to such offers can result in financial loss.

question: I gave my OTP and allowed screen sharing to someone who called me from my bank. What do I do now to keep my money safe?
reference_answer: immediately call 1930 and change your account password or block/freeze your card to prevent further financial loss.

question: My phone number is not registered with my bank. How can I register it for mobile banking?
reference_answer: You can register your mobile number by visiting a bank branch, using an ATM, a passbook printing kiosk, or a Business Correspondent point with biometric authentication, as these channels allow the bank to capture and update your mobile number in their system.

question: मैं व्हाट्सएप पर एक निवेश ऐप की धोखाधड़ी का शिकार हुआ हूं, मुझे शिकायत कहां करनी चाहिए?
reference_answer: You can report the suspected fraud through the Chakshu portal on Sanchar Saathi or call the cyber helpline at 1930 for help.

question: I got a call saying I’ve won money from overseas and need to pay a fee to receive it – what should I do?
reference_answer: RBI advisories warn that people should not pay any fee to receive money from abroad, as these are fictitious offers and RBI never asks for bank account details or charges to release funds.

question: I borrowed money from a loan app and now they're harassing me for more money than I owe. What should I do and how can I check if the app is real?
reference_answer: You can report the app to law enforcement or file a complaint through the RBI Sachet portal at https://sachet.rbi.org.in, and you should verify the lender's registration with RBI or the State Government before proceeding.

question: I received a call saying my bank account will be blocked unless I update my KYC right away, what should I do?
reference_answer: Contact your bank directly through official channels to verify the request, and do not share any personal or account details with unknown callers.

question: I received a small amount like ₹50 from an unknown UPI, and a caller says it was sent by mistake and asks me to send it back. What will happen next?
reference_answer: You will then receive a UPI collect request for a much larger amount, disguised as the "refund".

question: I got a message on WhatsApp saying I can earn sure profits from a trading app, and I'm asked to send money to a different bank account. What should I do?
reference_answer: Promising sure profits is a scam, and legitimate trading platforms never ask for payments to third-party accounts. Only download apps from official stores and avoid unverified links.

question: I got a message saying money was sent to my UPI account by mistake and I need to send it back. But when I entered my PIN, a larger amount was deducted from my account. Why is this happening?
reference_answer: The message claims money was sent by mistake and asks you to return it, but it is actually a collect request for a larger amount disguised as a refund. When you enter your UPI PIN to return the money, you approve the larger payment instead.

question: How do I know if a loan app I received via message is safe?
reference_answer: You can verify the app by checking if it is connected to a bank or NBFC approved by the Reserve Bank on their official website. Also, avoid downloading apps received through SMS or social media links, and report any suspicious app to law enforcement agencies.

question: I shared my bank OTP with a caller and money was stolen from my account. Will the bank refund me, or am I responsible for the full amount?
reference_answer: Until you report the unauthorized transaction to the bank, you bear the entire loss if it was due to sharing your payment credentials; any loss after reporting is borne by the bank.

question: I got a message on WhatsApp about an app that claims I can earn quick money. What should I do if I think it's a scam?
reference_answer: You should report the suspicious activity to the cyber cell or call the I4C helpline at 1930. You can also visit the SEBI investor support page or cybercrime.gov.in for help.

question: டெபிட் கார்டில் கவனம் எல்லாமல் பணி எழுதியurus. எனது பொருள் என்ன மற்றும் எப்போது பேங்குக்கு அறிவிக்க வேண்டும்?
reference_answer: The passage states that the cardholder bears loss up to the time of notification to the bank, but only up to a fixed amount or percentage agreed upon in advance, except in cases of fraud or extreme negligence. The bank is also required to provide a means for customers to notify loss or theft at any time, and must take action to stop further card use upon notification.

question: विदेश से लॉटरी या पैसों का झूठा ऑफर आया है, मुझे क्या करना चाहिए?
reference_answer: The passage advises that individuals who receive fictitious offers of money from abroad should immediately register a complaint with the local police or cyber crime authorities, as the RBI does not undertake such money arrangements nor recover remitted funds.

question: मैं एक डिजिटल लोन ऐप का इस्तेमाल कर रहा हूं, लेकिन ऐप ने मुझे यह नहीं बताया कि असल में लोन किस बैंक या NBFC ने दिया है। मुझे शिकायत करने का अधिकार है या नहीं?
reference_answer: The passage explains that digital lending platforms often do not disclose the name of the bank or NBFC at the backend, due to which customers cannot access the grievance redressal avenues provided under the regulatory framework.

question: व्हाट्सएप पर मुझे कोई अनजान व्यक्ति 'फ्री ट्रेडिंग कोर्स' का लिंक भेज रहा है, मैं ये check करूं कि वो SEBI registered है या फिर कोई स्कैम?
reference_answer: SEBI advises investors to verify the registration status of any entity at https://www.sebi.gov.in/intermediaries.html and to conduct transactions only through authentic trading apps listed at https://investor.sebi.gov.in/Investor-support.html, since scammers often impersonate registered intermediaries on WhatsApp/Telegram.

question: என் ব্যாங்க் கணக்கில் எல்லாமல் பணி கழித்தது. என்னை ரபர்ட் செய்ய எப்படி? என்னை எந்த வரை பாதிப்படை இல்லை?
reference_answer: The passage states that banks must display their customer protection policy on the website along with grievance handling details, and for debit card or bank account transactions, the customer does not suffer loss of interest. Additionally, the burden of proving customer liability lies on the bank.

question: If I suspect unauthorized activity, how can I immediately stop all online payments from my account?
reference_answer: Banks offer a facility to instantly disable all digital payments from your account through phone banking, internet banking, or a branch visit, and restarting payments requires re-verification either digitally with strict checks or by visiting the bank in person.

question: I received a message saying my KYC needs updating and asking me to click a link, what should I do?
reference_answer: Do not click the link, as it may be fraudulent and could lead to money loss. The public is advised not to fall prey to frauds being perpetrated in the name of KYC updation.

question: ஒரு அஞ்சனம் என்னை UPI மூலம் ₹10 sent panni, அவன் erroneously sent என்று கூறி திரும்பி கொடுக்க வேண்டும் என்று அழைத்து வருகிறான். எனக்கு என்ன செய்ய வேண்டும்?
reference_answer: The passage states that after a stranger sends a small amount (₹10, ₹50 or more) via UPI, they call claiming it was sent by mistake and urgently ask the victim to return it, which is followed by a UPI collect request for a larger amount disguised as a refund; entering the UPI PIN in this situation leads to losing money.

question: I got a message on WhatsApp from an investment app asking me to invest in securities, how can I check if it's genuine and SEBI-registered?
reference_answer: You can verify the app's registration status on the official SEBI links for registered intermediaries and trading apps, and note that legitimate service calls come from the new '1600' phone number series, not regular 10-digit numbers.

question: I shared my bank OTP with a scammer and money was taken from my account. Do I have to pay back the full amount, or will the bank cover some of it?
reference_answer: If the loss occurred because you shared your payment details, you are responsible for the full amount until you report the incident to the bank. After you report it, the bank bears any further loss.

question: RBI के नाम पर मुझे कॉल आई और मेरे बैंक अकाउंट की जानकारी मांगने लगी, मैं क्या करूं?
reference_answer: RBI never asks for your bank account details, so you should not share them with anyone. If someone claims to be from RBI and asks for money or details, you should complain to local police or cyber crime authorities.

question: உபி ஐ வரை 환னா வரை வந்தது. எனது_pin உள்ளடக்கம் கொடுக்க வேண்டியா?
reference_answer: Do not enter your UPI PIN, as it approves a larger unauthorized payment instead of returning the money. Verify the request through official channels and report immediately to 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in.

question: व्हाट्सएप या टेलीग्राम पर कोई ट्रेडिंग ऐप दिखे, जो जल्दी ज्यादा मुनाफा देने का वादा करे, क्या वो भरोसेमंद होता है?
reference_answer: The passage warns that scammers lure investors with promises of high returns through fake trading apps and social media groups, indicating such offers are typically untrustworthy.

question: ஒரு அழைப்பில் RBI ஆசிரியர் போலும் பேசி, என் பங்குதொகை தகவல்களை கேட்டார். என்ன செய்ய வேண்டும்?
reference_answer: The passage warns that bank account or card details should not be shared with unknown callers or email senders, and such contacts should be reported to the local police or cyber crime authority.

question: I received a call from someone claiming to be from my bank, saying there's an issue with my account and asking me to share the OTP I got on my phone. What should I do?
reference_answer: You should never share the OTP with anyone, and you can call 1930 to report the incident and block your card to prevent financial loss.

question: அன்பு, எனக்கு காலை வந்தது உங்கள் சேவையில் பிரச்சினை என்னிடம் கூறி, அப்பில் அப্প் பதிவர்த்து வைத்தார். என்ன செய்ய வேண்டும்?
reference_answer: Immediately block the scam number and contact the organization directly through official channels. Never share personal, financial, or login details over the phone.

question: I invested money in a trading app after seeing it promoted on WhatsApp, but now I can't withdraw my money. What should I do?
reference_answer: The app initially shows fake profits to lure victims into investing more, but later blocks withdrawals and demands fees or excuses. You should stop all further investment and report the incident to the cybercrime helpline.

question: मैंने अपने बैंक खाते से बिना बताए पैसे कटते देखे। मुझे बैंक को तुरंत सूचना देनी चाहिए, देर करने पर मेरा नुकसान बढ़ जाएगा क्या?
reference_answer: You must notify your bank of the unauthorised transaction at the earliest, as delaying the report increases your risk of loss.

question: I was told I've won a government scheme or lottery, and they're asking me to pay a small fee to release the money. Could this be a real offer from the RBI?
reference_answer: This is a scam where fraudsters pretend to be from the RBI or government, ask for small fees such as processing charges, and after receiving money, they keep demanding more before vanishing with the funds. Report it to your local police or cyber crime station, and you can also file a complaint with the RBI-listed nodal agencies for such fictitious offers.

question: I received a message from an unknown person saying they sent money to my payment app by mistake, and now they're asking me to enter my PIN to confirm it. Is this safe?
reference_answer: You don't need a UPI PIN or OTP to receive money.

question: I got a call from someone saying they're from the Reserve Bank of India, asking for my debit card PIN and the three-digit code on the back. Is this a real RBI call?
reference_answer: The Reserve Bank of India does not call or email people asking for debit card PINs or CVV numbers, and no legitimate bank requests such details over the phone or via email.

question: I got a message on WhatsApp about an app that promises you can make money with zero chance of losing. What should I check to know if it's real or a scam?
reference_answer: The passage warns about fake platforms that promise easy profits with no risk, and it tells investors to verify that any service is officially registered with SEBI and uses authentic apps.

question: I notice a debit I didn't agree to in my account. What are the next steps, and will I lose my money?
reference_answer: The passage directs customers to report unauthorised transactions to their bank and states that revised RBI criteria determine the customer's liability, which may be limited or zero depending on the circumstances.

question: என் கணக்கு blocked ஆகவா? KYC அப்டேட் link भेजியர், என்ன செய்ய வேண்டும்?
reference_answer: Do not click the link or enter your UPI PIN/OTP. Always access your bank's official website or contact the branch directly, and never share confidential details like your PIN or OTP with anyone.

question: கைமுகை KYC மோசடி ஏற்பட்டபோது என்ன செய்ய வேண்டும்?
reference_answer: The passage advises victims to contact the cyber-crime helpline at 1930 or visit https://www.cybercrime.gov.in for assistance.

question: My bank asked me to share an OTP and give remote access to my device, and now I've been scammed – what security measures should have prevented this?
reference_answer: The service provider should protect access credentials such as OTPs and authentication information against leakage and attacks, enforce strong password policies and two-factor or multi-factor authentication, and implement a centralised identity and access management system to control and monitor privileged access.

question: Mujhe koi trading app bahut high returns ka promise raha hai, lekin main uski reality check kaise kar sakti hoon? kya main SEBI website par check kar sakti hoon?
reference_answer: You can verify if your broker is SEBI-registered by checking on SEBI’s official website. Also, always use the official app or website of a registered broker for fund transfers, and avoid sending money to personal accounts.

question: I got a message about a problem with my bank account, and someone sent me an app to install. What should I do?
reference_answer: Banks never ask you to download an app through social media platforms, and you should avoid installing apps from unknown sources. Also, never share your OTP or banking credentials with anyone.

question: मुझे कॉल आई की मेरा बैंक अकाउंट बंद होने वाला है, उन्होनें मुझे ऐप डाउनलोड करने के लिए कहा। मुझे क्या करना चाहिए?
reference_answer: The passage advises not to share personal, financial, or login details, avoid installing apps or clicking links, and instead contact the organization directly using official channels. It also recommends blocking the scam number immediately to stay safe.

question: I saw an unauthorized deduction from my bank account. What are my chances of getting my money back, and how quickly do I need to act?
reference_answer: Reporting the unauthorized transaction within 3 working days of the bank's communication may give you zero liability for third-party faults, while reporting within 4 to 7 working days limits your loss to ₹5,000 or ₹10,000 depending on your account type. If you were negligent (e.g., shared credentials), you are responsible for the loss until you report it, after which the bank covers any further transactions.

question: I received an email that says it's from the Reserve Bank of India, asking me to update my bank account details to keep my account safe. Is this really from RBI?
reference_answer: No, the Reserve Bank of India does not send emails asking customers to update account details or install software, and it does not use email addresses ending in @rbi.com. Such messages are phishing attempts that could result in identity theft.

question: I received a call saying I'm under investigation by the police for something I didn't do, and they're threatening to arrest me unless I pay money on WhatsApp. What should I do?
reference_answer: Government agencies do not use WhatsApp or Skype for official communication, and legitimate law enforcement never asks for payment details. Stay calm and do not panic, as scammers use fake case numbers and aggressive threats to pressure victims.

question: Main koi aur se phone par baat kar rahi thi, unhone kaha ki unhone meri payment app par paise bhej diye hain aur mera OTP chahiye. main kya karun?
reference_answer: Never share OTPs or passwords with unverified contacts, and always seek help from verified cybersecurity professionals using official contact details.

question: I got a message from my bank about a transaction I didn’t authorize. What’s the quickest way to report it to the bank and get an acknowledgment right away?
reference_answer: The bank must provide 24x7 reporting channels and will immediately send an acknowledgment with a registered complaint number.

question: I received a message claiming to be from the RBI asking for my bank account details to transfer a large fund. What should I do?
reference_answer: The RBI does not ask for bank account details, and such messages should not be replied to. The local police or cybercrime authority should be contacted immediately.

question: I took a loan from a digital app, but I don't know which bank or financial company actually provided it. The app is harassing me and I don't know where to report it. What should I do?
reference_answer: The passage states that many digital lending platforms portray themselves as lenders without disclosing the name of the bank or NBFC at the backend, which means customers are not able to access the grievance redressal avenues available under the regulatory framework.

question: எனக்கு லோன் அப்பில் பணம் அளிக்க வேண்டியால், எப்படி தெரியும் அது சலுகை?
reference_answer: The passage explains that loan apps offering quick money with little or no paperwork, asking for advance fees or bank access, or lacking an RBI NBFC license are likely scams targeting financially distressed individuals, and that scrutinizing interest rates and terms is essential to identify them.

question: I got a call saying my bank KYC is expired and I must share my debit card number and OTP right away, or my account will be blocked. Is this a real bank call?
reference_answer: No legitimate bank or the RBI will ever call, SMS, or email you out of the blue asking for your card details, OTP, or bank account information. If you receive such a request, it is a scam and you should report it to your local police or cyber crime authority.

question: मेरा बैंक खाते से बिना बताए पैसे कट गए। मुझे बैंक को कब सूचना देनी चाहिए ताकि मेरा पैसा वापस मिल सके और मुझे कोई नुकसान न हो?
reference_answer: If you inform the bank within 3 working days of the unauthorized transaction and there is no negligence on your part, you have no liability and the bank must credit the amount to your account within 10 working days.

question: मुझे RBI के नाम पर मेल आया है कि मेरा बैंक अकाउंट सुरक्षित करने के लिए मुझे अपनी जानकारी देनी होगी, क्या यह सच है?
reference_answer: The RBI has not sent any email asking customers to update their account details or download attachments, and it does not use email IDs with the @rbi.com extension. Such messages are phishing attempts that could lead to identity theft.

question: ஸ்கேம் தவிர்க்க என் கணக்கில் இருந்து டிஜிட்டல் பணி எப்படி நிறுத்தி பாதுகாக்கலாம்? மீண்டும் தொடர்க்க எப்படி?
reference_answer: The passage explains that a customer can immediately disable all digital payment transactions and banking access from their account, and these can only be restored after the bank verifies their identity, either through digital authentication or by visiting a branch in person.

question: I got a message saying I won a lottery and RBI will help me get the money, but they're asking me to pay a fee first. Is this really from RBI?
reference_answer: RBI does not send emails or calls about lottery winnings or funds from abroad, and it never asks for any fee to release money. Such messages are scams, and you should immediately report them to the police or cybercrime authority.

question: I received a call saying my bank KYC needs urgent update, what is the safe way to proceed?
reference_answer: You should directly contact your bank or financial institution for confirmation, using only official sources to get their customer care number, and enquire with your bank branch about the available modes for updating your KYC details.

question: ஒரு அஞ்சரை உங்கள் UPI மூலம் ₹50 சென்று வரைச்சு. பின்னர் அவர் கேட்டு, 'தவறு சென்றது' என்கிறார். என்ன செய்ய வேண்டும்?
reference_answer: The caller is scamming you: after sending a small amount like ₹50, they will claim it was a mistake and ask you to return it, then a larger UPI collect request for ₹5,000 will arrive disguised as a refund, and entering your PIN will authorize the theft.

question: I received a call saying I won a lottery and RBI is sending me money from abroad, but they’re asking for a processing fee. Is this real?
reference_answer: The Reserve Bank of India never contacts individuals about lottery winnings or overseas fund transfers, and it never asks for fees or processing charges. Such calls are fraudulent, and you should immediately report them to the local police or cybercrime authority.

question: I'm getting non-stop calls from a loan app demanding money, threatening me with police arrest, but they won't tell me which bank gave me the loan. Who is the real lender and how can I complain?
reference_answer: Since the platform does not disclose the name of the bank or NBFC providing the loan, you cannot directly access the grievance redressal mechanisms meant for regulated entities; the actual lender is the bank or NBFC behind the platform, which must follow the Fair Practices Code and can be contacted for complaints.

question: I received an SMS saying my KYC needs immediate update and asking me to click a link. What should I do?
reference_answer: You should not click the link, as it may be fraudulent. The RBI has warned the public not to fall for KYC update scams.

question: I received a call from a loan app claiming I borrowed money. What is the app required to tell me about the bank behind it?
reference_answer: The app must disclose the name of the bank or NBFC it is working for upfront before I interact further.

question: I got a call about my KYC being expired and they asked for my bank details, what should I do?
reference_answer: The RBI advises never to share your account or bank details with anyone, as unexpected requests for them are scams aiming to steal money.

question: Someone messages me saying I've won a large fund or lottery from abroad, but I need to pay a small fee first to get it, what should I do?
reference_answer: You should not pay any money to receive large funds or lottery winnings, and you can register your complaint with the local police or cyber crime authorities.

question: I received a one-time password from my bank for a payment, but it disappears before I can enter it. How long is it actually valid?
reference_answer: The Reserve Bank of India suggests that one-time passwords should not remain valid for more than 100 seconds on either side of the server clock, keeping the valid period very short to lower the chance of misuse.

question: I got a call saying there's a problem with my bank or trading app, and the caller asked me to install an app or click a link. What should I do?
reference_answer: If you are unsure, contact the organization directly using their official contact details, and never share your personal, financial, or login details over the phone. You should also block the scam number immediately to prevent repeat calls.

question: RBI के नाम पर कॉल आ रही है कि मुझे लॉटरी लग गई है, मुझे अपने बैंक अकाउंट से पैसा ट्रांसफर करना चाहिए, मुझे क्या करना चाहिए?
reference_answer: Do not share your OTP or personal details with unidentified persons, and contact your bank branch if you receive such requests.

question: Main payment app par accident se ek andaray se paise paaye, kya yeh bhi scam hai? main kya karun?
reference_answer: The passage warns that if a stranger accidentally sends money on a payment app, it might be an online payment app scam, so one should beware.

question: How many days does the bank have to refund my money after I report an unauthorized transaction?
reference_answer: The bank must resolve your complaint and refund your money within 90 days from the date they receive it. If they cannot do so, they must pay the compensation to you immediately.

question: I noticed an unauthorized debit in my bank account. How quickly do I need to inform the bank to avoid losing my money?

question: I got a call from someone claiming to be from the RBI or a government agency, saying my bank account will be blocked unless I share my OTP and install a given app. Is this real?
